findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 10 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 20 questions numbered 1-20; by section: 10.1 2, 10.2 2, 10.3 2, 10.4 2, 10.5 2, 10.6 4, 10.7 2, 10.8 2, 10.10 2.

10 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering the force on a current-carrying conductor, magnetic flux, flux linkage, the force on a moving charge and its circular path, the velocity selector with q/m, motional emf, Faraday's law, Lenz's law and energy conservation, the factors affecting emf, and the seismometer. Ferrofluids (no numerical in the chapter) are covered in the MCQs and short questions only. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: Fleming's rule is Fig. 10.3; the flux-rate law is Eq. 10.23.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
